input.prompt: Redraw this RimWorld helmet sprite with far more detail and craftsmanship, as a professional RimWorld mod artist would. KEEP the exact same silhouette, size and position on the canvas. Bevels, seams and wear, flat cel shading lit from the upper left, thick pure black outlines, near-black metal with dark grey highlights so the shapes still read. Only the helmet, no head or face inside it. Plain flat pure white background, no text, no shadow
